3M PFAS Settlement Payout: Up to $12.5B, Paid Through 2036

3M PFAS settlement payout, on a timeline. Up to $12.5 billion to resolve public water systems' claims, paid annually from 2024 through 2036 (3M 8-K, Jun 22, 2023). About ten years to go (our math). 3M does not admit any liability.

See you in 2036.

descripcion:
3M PFAS settlement payout: when does the money actually get paid? Not all at once. 3M's 8-K from June 22, 2023 says 3M will pay $10.5 billion to $12.5 billion in total to resolve the claims of public water systems, with payments made annually from 2024 through 2036.

PFAS are a family of man-made chemicals often called "forever chemicals". This settlement covers PFAS in public water systems, the utilities that deliver drinking water.

How long is left? From today, about ten years of payments (our math: 2036 minus 2026). The timeline in the video marks where we are.

3M does not admit any liability or wrongdoing, according to the same filing.

See you in 2036. We'll check back every year.

Source: 3M Form 8-K, Jun 22, 2023 (SEC).
